event.text: The JS code uses box from THREE.Box3 and expands by min/max from the accessor - but those are in GLB space. So we need to transform each vertex to compose when we expand the box and when we sum the centroid. So: when we read posArray we have (xg, yg, zg). We transform to compose (xg, -xg, yg). So we need to not use box.expandByPoint with raw min/max from the accessor - we need to iterate over each vertex, transform to compose, then expand. So the flow: for each vertex (xg, yg, zg), compute (sx, sy, sz) = (xg, -xg, yg), then expand box by (sx, sy, sz), and add (sx, sy, sz) to centroidSum. Then dimensions from compose box. Footprint = dimX * dimZ. And we need to change the interface to use Point type. Point in JS is {x, y, z}. So out.boundingBoxMin = {x: min.x, y: min.y, z: min.z} etc. Let me do the full JS update.
